questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word. EFFICIENT
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

EFFICIENT
questions.solution:
Here the correct answer is Idle.

Key Points

  • Let's look at the meaning of the given word:-
    • Efficient - (of a system or machine) achieving maximum productivity with minimum wasted effort or expense; (of a person) working in a well-organized and competent way. (कुशल)
  • Let's look at the meaning of the words given in options:-
    • Idle - avoiding work; lazy. (काम से बचना; काम चोर)
    • Expert - a person who is very knowledgeable about or skillful in a particular area. (विशेषज्ञ)
    • Common - occurring, found, or done often; prevalent. (सामान्य)
    • Clever - quick to understand, learn, and devise or apply ideas; intelligent. (चतुर)
  • Thus, after looking at the meaning of the given words, it is clear that the correct antonym for 'efficient' is 'idle'.
  • Therefore, the correct answer is Option 3.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word. RIDICULOUS
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

RIDICULOUS
questions.solution: Ridiculous  means 'stupid or unreasonable and deserving to be laughed at'. Antonym of ridiculous is 'reasonable' which means 'sensible or logical'. Example: The idea of flying cars may seem ridiculous, but it could become reasonable in the future.

questions.question: Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word. Hilarious
questions.questionHtml:
Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Hilarious
questions.solution: The correct answer is 'Humourless​.' 'Hilarious' means extremely funny. Example: The comedian's jokes left the audience in hilarious laughter. 'Humourless' means having no sense of fun; serious. Example: His humorless attitude made everyone uncomfortable.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word. Medicines should be ordered by the generic name, not by the proprietary or trade name.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

Medicines should be ordered by the generic name, not by the proprietary or trade name.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'General'.

Key Points

  •  This is a synonym in context question.
  •  We need to choose that option which is the synonym of the word underlined in the given sentence.
  • Here, the underlined word 'Generic' means shared by, including or typical of a whole group of things; not specific, general.(जो किसी समूह की सभी वस्‍तुओं में समान हो या उनका प्रातिनिधिक हो; अविशिष्‍ट)
  • Thus, the synonym of the given word 'generic' is given in options as one of its meaning and that is 'General'.
  • Therefore, the correct answer is option 2.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word. SUBTLE
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word. 

SUBTLE
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'harsh'.

Key Points

  • The most appropriate antonym of the given word 'Subtle' is 'Harsh'.
  • Subtle: not very noticeable; not very strong or bright. (बहुत गाढ़ा या चमकदार नहीं, हलका; सूक्ष्‍म, बारीक)
    • Example: He gave subtle hints, which I totally failed to notice.
  • Harsh: having an undesirably strong effect; unpleasantly rough or jarring to the senses. (कठोर; अवांछित रूप से मजबूत प्रभाव होना; अप्रिय रूप से खुरदरा या इंद्रियों को झकझोरने वाला)
    • Example: He was sentenced to a harsh prison term.
       

Correct Answer: Harsh.

Additional Information

  • Let's look at the meaning of other words:
    • crafty: clever at getting or achieving things by using unfair or dishonest methods. (अनुचित तरीक़े से कुछ प्राप्त करने में चालाक; धूर्त, चालाक, चालबाज़)
    • faint: to lose consciousness. (मूर्छित हो जाना)
    • slight: very small; not important or serious. (बहुत छोटा; बड़ा या गंभीर नहीं, मामूली)

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word. HEFTY
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

HEFTY
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'slight'. 

Key Points

  • Hefty is an adjective that means large and heavy (बड़ा और भारी।)
    • Example - He was a tall, hefty man.
  • The meaning of the given options are as follows - 
    • handsome - (of a man) good-looking. ((एक आदमी का) अच्छा दिखने वाला।)
    • generous - showing a readiness to give more of something, especially money, than is strictly necessary or expected. (कड़ाई से आवश्यक या अपेक्षित से कुछ अधिक, विशेष रूप से धन देने की तत्परता दिखाना।)
    • slight - (of a person or their build) not sturdy; thin or slender. ((किसी व्यक्ति या उनके निर्माण का) मजबूत नहीं; पतला।
    • liberal - willing to respect or accept behavior or opinions different from one's own; open to new ideas. (अपने से अलग व्यवहार या राय का सम्मान या स्वीकार करने के लिए तैयार; नए विचारों के लिए खुला।)
  • From the above meanings, it is evident that slight is the correct antonym for the word hefty.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word. Moil
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Moil
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: Discourage

Key Points 

  • Moil means to work hard; drudge. (कठिन परिश्रम करके; परिश्रम से काम करना)
    • Example - Greta devoted her mornings to moil in the gym's weight room.
  • Marked option Discourage means cause someone to lose confidence or enthusiasm. (किसी के आत्मविश्वास या उत्साह को खोने का कारण)
    • Example - We want to discourage children from smoking.
  • It is clear that 'Moil' and 'Discourage' are opposite in meaning.

Therefore the correct answer is option 3.​

Additional Information 

  • Cultivate means try to acquire or develop a quality or skill. (किसी गुण या कौशल को प्राप्त करने या विकसित करने का प्रयास करें)
  • Grow means become larger or greater over a period of time; increase. (समय की अवधि में बड़ा या बड़ा हो जाना; बढ़ोतरी)
  • Work means activity involving mental or physical effort done in order to achieve a purpose or result. (किसी उद्देश्य या परिणाम को प्राप्त करने के लिए किए गए मानसिक या शारीरिक प्रयास से जुड़ी गतिविधि)

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence. The list included many mundane , routine tasks.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

The list included many mundane, routine tasks.
questions.solution:
Here the correct answer is Exceptional.

Key Points

  • The most appropriate antonym of the underlined word "mundane" in the given sentence is "exceptional" (Option 4).
  • Mundane means "lacking interest or excitement; dull; of this earthly world rather than a heavenly or spiritual one." In the given sentence, mundane is used to describe routine tasks that are uninteresting or boring. (साधारण)
    • For example: I'm tired of doing mundane tasks like washing dishes and folding laundry.
  • Exceptional, on the other hand, means "unusual, rare, or outstanding; unusually good or impressive." (असाधारण)
    • For example: She gave an exceptional performance in the play.
  • Therefore, "exceptional" is the most appropriate antonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.

Additional Information

  • Explanation of other options:
  • Standard (Option 1) means "a level of quality or attainment." It is not an antonym of mundane. (सामान्य, मानक)
  • Temporal (Option 2) means "relating to worldly as opposed to spiritual affairs; secular." It is not an antonym of mundane. (अस्थायी,सांसारिक)
  • Customary (Option 3) means "according to or depending on custom; usual." It is not an antonym of mundane. (व्यावहारिक,प्रचलित)

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word. Alleviate
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Alleviate
questions.solution: Alleviate means to reduce the severity of something. Example: The medicine helped alleviate her pain. Aggravate means to make something worse or more serious. Example: His careless driving aggravated the situation.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word OBESE
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word

OBESE
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Skinny'.

Key Points

  • The most appropriate antonym of the given word 'Obese' is 'Skinny'.
  • Obese: (used about people) very fat, in a way that is not healthy. [(व्‍यक्ति) बहुत मोटा, स्‍थूलकाय (जो स्‍वस्‍थ होने का लक्षण नहीं)]
    • Example: Obese patients are advised to change their diet.
  • Skinny: (used about a person) too thin. [(व्‍यक्ति) दुबला-पतला; सींकिया]
    • Example: At school, I was fairly skinny and undersized.
       

Correct Answer: Skinny.

Additional Information

  • Let's look at the meaning of other words:
    • Rude: not polite. [अशिष्‍ट (किसी के प्रति) (किसी बात पर)]
    • Paunchy: having a large or protruding belly. (एक बड़ा या फैला हुआ पेट होना)
    • Cute: attractive; pretty. (आकर्षक; सुंदर)

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word. RENOWNED
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

RENOWNED
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Obscure'

Key Points

  • Renowned means famous or well known
  • Obscure means not discovered or known about. it's exactly the opposite of renowned.
    • Example: Rakesh was an obscure writer until a big publisher read his novel.

Additional Information

  • Vain: having or showing an excessively high opinion of one's appearance, abilities, or worth.
  • Noted: notice or pay particular attention to (something).
  • Glorious: having, worthy of, or bringing fame or admiration.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word. HINDER
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

HINDER
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'help'

Key Points

  • Let's look at the meaning of the words and an example.
  • Hinder: make it difficult for someone to do something or for something to happen.
  • Meaning of Antonyms:
    • help: making it easier for someone to do something by offering one's services or resources
    • heal: to make or become well again, especially after a cut or other injury.
    • hope: a feeling of expectation and desire for a particular thing to happen
    • hire: employ someone for wages

Hence, the correct antonym for hinder is help.

  • Example: I offered to help her in moving out but she had too much pride to accept it.

Hinglish

  • Hinder: बाधा ड़ालना
  • विलोम शब्द
    • help: सहारा देना
    • heal: ठीक होना
    • hope: आशा
    • hire: मजदूरी पर रखना
  • Hinder का विलोम शब्द help है
  • Example: she was certain that no one would help her.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word. EAGER
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

EAGER
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Indifferent'.

Key Points

  • The most appropriate antonym of the given word 'Eager' is Indifferent'.
  • Eager: keenly expectant or interested. (बेहद उम्मीद या दिलचस्पी)
    • Example: Small eager faces looked up and listened.
  • Indifferent: not interested in or care about somebody/something. (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु में रुचि या सोच-विचार से रहित; उदासीन)
    • Example: The manager of the shop seemed indifferent to our complaints.
       

Correct Answer: Indifferent.

Additional Information

  • Let's look at the meaning of other words:
    • Easier: not difficult. (आसान, सरल)
    • Different: not the same. (भिन्‍न, अलग प्रकार का, एक जैसा नहीं)
    • Loveable: having a personality or appearance that is easy to love. (प्‍यारा लगने वाला, आकर्षक)

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word. Relapse
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Relapse
questions.solution: 'Relapse' means deterioration in health after a temporary improvement. Example: The patient experienced a relapse. 'Improve' means make or become better. Example: The new medication helped improve his condition.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word. PROFUSE
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

PROFUSE
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Scant'.

Key Points

  • The most appropriate antonym of the given word 'Profuse' is 'Scant'.
  • Profuse: given or produced in great quantity. (अत्‍यधिक मात्रा में, प्रचुर)
    • Example: profuse apologies...
  • Scant: not very much; not as much as necessary. [अत्‍यल्‍प (बहुत अधिक नहीं); अपर्याप्त (जितना अपेक्षित हो उतना नहीं)]
    • Example: Food was in scant supply.
       

Correct Answer: Scant.

Additional Information

  • Let's look at the meaning of other words:
    • Sufficient: as much as is necessary; enough. (जितना आवश्‍यक हो उतना; पर्याप्त)
    • Lush: (used about plants or gardens) growing very thickly and well. [(पौधे या बग़ीचे) घने और हरे-भरे]
    • Plenty: as much or as many of something as you need. (प्रचुर, बहुतायत, भरपूर)

questions.question: Select the most appropriate antonym of the word Startle
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the word

Startle

 Explanation:

questions.question: In the following question, out of the four alternatives, select the word opposite in the meaning of the word given. POMPOUS
questions.questionHtml:
In the following question, out of the four alternatives, select the word opposite in the meaning of the word given.

POMPOUS
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 4 i.e. Humble.

Key Points

Pompous means affectedly grand, solemn, or self-important.

  • Let's look at the meanings of the given words-
    • Arrogant means having or revealing an exaggerated sense of one's own importance or abilities.
    • Calm means not showing or feeling nervousness, anger, or other strong emotions.
    • Impatient means having or showing a tendency to be quickly irritated or provoked.
    • Humble means having or showing a modest or low estimate of one's importance.

Clearly, 'humble' is the correct word.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word. Blissful
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Blissful
questions.solution: 'Blissful' Extremely happy or joyful. Example - They spent a blissful day at the beach. 'Miserable' Extremely unhappy or wretched. Example - The poor living conditions made the refugees miserable.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence. It will have detrimental effects on the healing process.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

It will have detrimental effects on the healing process.
questions.solution: Detrimental: Causing harm or damage. Example - Smoking is detrimental to health. Benign: Not harmful or dangerous. Example - The tumor was found to be benign and non-cancerous.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word. Flexible
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Flexible
questions.solution: Flexible means easily adaptable, while Defiant means openly disobedient. Example of Flexible: The gymnast was flexible enough to perform difficult moves. Example of Defiant: The protesters were defiant in their stance against the government.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word. Serene
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Serene
questions.solution: 'Serene' Calm, peaceful, and undisturbed. Example - The view of the lake at sunset was serene. 'Agitated' A state of restlessness or excitement. Example - The loud noise agitated the baby, causing him to cry.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word. SLACKEN
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

SLACKEN
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Intensify'.

Key Points

  • The most appropriate antonym of the given word 'Slacken' is 'Intensify'.
  • Slacken: to become or make something slower or less active. धीमा हो जाना या कर देना
    • Example: He slackened off his pace towards the end of the race.
  • Intensify: to become or to make something greater or stronger. तीव्रतर, प्रबल या उग्रतर हो जाना या कर देना
    • Example: Fighting in the region has intensified.
       

Correct Answer: Intensify.

Additional Information

  • Let's look at the meaning of other words:
    • Relax: to rest while you are doing something enjoyable, especially after work or effort. [आराम फ़रमाना, विश्राम करना (विशेषतः काम या श्रम के बाद)]
    • Retard: to delay something or make its development or progress slower. [(प्रगति या विकास) धीमा करना; देर करना, विलंब करना; बाधा डालना[
    • Weaken: to become less strong; to make somebody/something less strong. [कमज़ोर हो जाना; (व्‍यकि्त या वस्‍तु को) कमज़ोर कर देना]

questions.question: Directions: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word. CHERISH
questions.questionHtml:
Directions: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

CHERISH
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'disregard.'

Key Points

  • The given word 'Cherish' means to love somebody or something and look after him or her or it carefully. (किसी से स्‍नेह करना और सावधानीपूर्वक देखरेख में रखना)
    • Example: A man promises to cherish his wife.
  • ​Let's see the meaning of the given options:-
    • 'Distribute' means to give things to a number of people. (वितरण करना, बाँट देना)
      • Example: The relief agency will distribute the food among several countries.
    • 'Disperse' means to separate and go in different directions; to make somebody or something do this. (बिखर जाना, विसर्जित हो जाना; बिखरा देना, विसर्जित कर देना)
      • Example: Police used tear gas to disperse the crowd.
    • 'Disturb' means to interrupt somebody while he or she is doing something or sleeping; to spoil a peaceful situation. (किसी के कुछ काम करते समय उसमें बाधा पहुँचाना अथवा नींद में व्यवधान डालना; शांति भंग करना)
      • Example: Please don't disturb me while I'm working.
    • 'Disregard' means to take no notice of somebody or something; to treat something as unimportant. (किसी की उपेक्षा करना, किसी बात पर ध्यान न देना; किसी बात को महत्वहीन या उपेक्षणीय समझना)
      • Example: She shows a total disregard for other people's feelings.
         

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

Additional Information

  • The antonyms of the word 'Cherish' are "disregard, ignore, neglect".
  • The synonyms of the word 'Cherish' are "retain, keep, preserve".

questions.question: Direction: In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the one which is opposite in the meaning of the given word. Scoff
questions.questionHtml:
Direction: In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the one which is opposite in the meaning of the given word.

Scoff
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Praise.'
Key Points

  • The word 'scoff' means 'mock or ridicule.'  ('Scoff' शब्द का अर्थ है 'मजाक या उपहास'।) 
    • Example: The critics scoffed at his paintings.
  • Let us see the meanings of the given options:
    • Contemn: to view or treat with contempt. (अवमानना ​​के साथ देखना या व्यवहार करना।)

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence. The ability to relax and rejuvenate promotes wellness.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

The ability to relax and rejuvenate promotes wellness.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is -'suppress'
Key Points ​

 

  • The verb "rejuvenate" means to restore, refresh or revitalize something or someone to a youthful or healthy state. (ताजगी लाना)
    • For example: After a long vacation, I feel rejuvenated and ready to tackle my work again.
  • "Update" means to make something more modern or up-to-date. (अद्यतन)
  • "Replenish" means to refill or restore something that has been used up. (पूरा करना)
  • "Suppress" (दबाना) means to prevent or restrain something. It is the opposite of "rejuvenate" as it involves inhibiting or limiting something instead of restoring it.
  • "Revive" means to bring back to life or consciousness. (पुनर्जीवित करना)
  • In summary, out of the given options, "suppress" is the most appropriate antonym of "rejuvenate," as it involves preventing or limiting something instead of restoring or refreshing it.
  • Therefore, the correct answer is: suppress.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word. CLEAR
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

CLEAR
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: Dim.

Key Points

  • The word "clear" means easy to understand, bright, or free from confusion or doubt. (स्पष्ट / साफ)
    • Example: The teacher gave a clear explanation of the topic.
  • "Dim" means not bright or not clear; lacking clarity or sharpness. (धुंधला / अस्पष्ट)
    • Example: The light in the room was too dim to read properly.
  • Hence, we can infer that the opposite of 'clear' is 'dim'.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Dim.

Additional Information

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings:

  • Doubt (संदेह): A feeling of uncertainty or lack of confidence.
  • Open (खुला): Not closed or allowing access; also can mean honest or frank.
  • Known (ज्ञात): Recognized or familiar to people.
